content: Which policy has the highest loss ratio, and what is it?

name: query_salesforce

content:
The policy with the highest loss ratio is [ANT-HO-205860](/lightning/r/a00aj00003jKVOsAAO/view). It's an active homeowners policy for [Park Household](/lightning/r/001aj000040sVmxAAE/view), with a loss ratio of **2,078.5%**. Its incurred losses are **$23,300**, against an annual premium of only **$1,121**.

The next two are very close behind:
- [ANT-HO-204585](/lightning/r/a00aj00003jKVNfAAO/view) for [Okafor Household](/lightning/r/001aj000040sVmRAAU/view) is at **2,008.9%** ($45,000 in losses on $2,240 premium).
- [ANT-PA-204857](/lightning/r/a00aj00003jKVNvAAO/view) for [Haddad Household](/lightning/r/001aj000040sVmZAAU/view) is at **2,006.9%** ($58,000 in losses on $2,890 premium).
